description: Source code for the Hpack Huffman decoder used in HTTP/2 header compression, including classes and functions for decoding Huffman-encoded data streams.

classes.name: HuffmanBitBuffer
classes.description: Manages a bit buffer for Huffman decoding, allowing appending bytes, consuming bits, and debugging.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs Huffman decoding of input data streams into output strings, using a predefined Huffman code table.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes Huffman-encoded input data into a string, returning true on success and false on error.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state of the Huffman bit buffer.
